label: early original-phase token after z/p/f in sequences starting u/q/c (soft conjunction)
explanation: Sparse feature (~0.03% of steps). 90% of mass is in the original phase at positions 3-5. It fires when several weak cues coincide: the previous input is z/p/f (prev_tok z gives 13x lift), the token two back is z/p/f/q, the sequence starts with u/q/c, and the current input is u/w/b/n/x/r. It behaves like a soft AND: the more cues present, the stronger the activation. Top examples (u q s z [w], u c z z [w], q z z [n]) have all of them. No single cue or clean conjunction separates it. Requiring prev_tok in {z,p,f} and at least 4 of the 5 cues gets about 58% of the mass at only about 17% precision. A smaller component (about 10% of mass) is at the first copy-phase step after <DEL> (recall_idx 1). It never fires at t=0-1, almost never at the delimiter or late in the copy phase, rarely on repeated tokens, and rarely when there are many digits.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=p (+5.65), prev_tok=z (+5.58), orig0=u (+5.34), recall_idx=1 (+5.09), orig0=c (+4.38), prev_tok=f (+4.15). Lower it: correct=1 (-6.10), orig_idx=-1 (-4.29), prev3_tok=- (-3.48), prev3_tok=u (-3.18).
